newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fernz NZ$150 mln notes fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Fernz NZ$150 mln notes fully subscribed.

text.p: New Zealand chemicals group Fernz Corporation Ltd said its NZ$150 million capital notes issue was heavily over-subscribed within minutes of its opening on Tuesday.
The company said the offer had been closed for all other than Fernz subscribers.
The April 15, 2002 notes bear 9.8 percent interest.

Fernz described the response as "an endorsement of the strategic investment and expansion programme Fernz is pursuing in establishing itself as an international company of significance in selected markets".
Fernz has said the proceeds from the issue will be used to replace existing debt and fund strategic acquisitions.
